title: Footnote to the Volume Discount Schedule: The Spend the Rate is Taken On, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
The season spend a volume discount is measured on is everything invoiced to the account over the fourteen statement months before the handling date, less every credit memo written on the account over those months, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places. Where that spend has run well past the programme's volume discount threshold, or where the growing crop is pledged, the spend the rate is taken on widens.

**Clause.** Where the season spend is at or above twice the programme's volume discount threshold, the rate is taken on the whole of the season spend. Where the season spend is at or above the programme's volume discount threshold but below twice it and a perfected security interest covering the growing crop is recorded on the account, the rate is taken on the whole of the season spend less half of that threshold. In every other case no such widening applies on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

**The thresholds themselves.** The programme's volume discount threshold, and twice it, stand as follows.

| Programme | Volume discount threshold (USD) | Twice the threshold (USD) | Half the threshold (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | 75000 | 150000 | 37500 |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | 150000 | 300000 | 75000 |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | 250000 | 500000 | 125000 |

**Worked on hypothetical figures.** On the Full Acre Input Financing Account, whose threshold is 150000.00 USD, a season spend of 310000.00 USD stands at or above twice that threshold, and the rate is taken on the whole 310000.00 USD. A season spend of 220000.00 USD on the same account stands above the threshold but below twice it: where a perfected security interest covering the growing crop is recorded on the account the rate is taken on 145000.00 USD, being the whole of the season spend less half of the threshold, and where no such interest is recorded no widening applies.
